usedFor: Help Scout holds the conversations, and Algodocs receives a file through “Upload Document” after “Note Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “Note Created” in Help Scout, then “Upload Document” in Algodocs
bestTemplate.why: A note is added when someone has something worth keeping, so the document is filed at that moment.

watchOut: “Upload Document” takes a file by URL or Base64, so the trigger must pass one along.
